criteria.requirement: Add SyntaxTreeNode.insert_child(index,node), append_child(node), remove_child(node) and replace_child(old,new). Maintain exactly one parent and consistent sibling traversal, moving an existing node out of its old parent; insertion indices are pre-move positions 0..len(children), adjusted when moving a preceding same-parent node. Reject root/self/ancestor insertion, leaf containers, wrong old parents and invalid indices before detaching anything. Synchronize actual token.children for inline/image containers so to_tokens followed by real rendering reflects edits. Keep existing read APIs and do not claim direct external list mutations are protected. Return inserted/removed nodes as documented, including idempotent self-replacement.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
